FinalProposition: The county school-inspectorate committee decides the receiving school placement and communicates the decision within the prescribed procedure.
Individual university admission follows the institution’s published regulation and selection criteria.
State-funded places are allocated through the annual plan and the institution’s applicable admission process.
EURES/Europass lets jobseekers create a CV/profile and share it with employers.
County employment agencies register eligible jobseekers and provide employment services under the relevant statutory conditions.
The stated minimum-wage amounts are statutory gross basic wages, before deductions required by law.
The 4,582 lei gross basic minimum applies to the construction sector under OUG 156/2024, Article LXIX, from 1 January 2025.

For the specific work route where qualification documents are unavailable, OUG 96/2024 requires a worker declaration and employer aptitude verification; a probation period may apply under its conditions.
OUG 96/2024 Article 4 defines the health package for its covered Ukraine-related beneficiary categories and its own contribution treatment.
Ordinary insured categories and exemptions are set out separately in Law 95/2006, Article 224.
Employment income contribution rules arise under the Tax Code; ordinary insured classification follows the separate categories in Law 95/2006.
For routine care, check the applicable package and referral/coverage rules with CNAS or the healthcare provider.
OUG 96/2024 provides for accommodation at sites designated through the competent local-authority process.
State child allowance and child-raising allowance each have distinct statutory eligibility and application rules.
Children of foreign citizens or stateless residents may qualify for state child allowance when they live in Romania with their parents, under Law 61/1993.
EU temporary protection includes stateless people and third-country nationals who held permanent residence in Ukraine and cannot safely and durably return.
From 5 August 2026, the EU military-obligation condition applies to the covered category specified in Council Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/1912, Article 2.
Each person registering for temporary protection must appear in person before the competent IGI structure.
IGI photographs each person during temporary-protection registration.
IGI issues the temporary-protection residence permit without charge.
Romanian implementing rules tie the permit validity period to the EU temporary-protection period; the current EU scheme ends on 4 March 2028.
OUG 96/2024 provides a specific work-purpose residence route for qualifying current or former temporary-protection beneficiaries.
Romania’s ordinary study, family and other residence procedures are governed by the purpose-specific provisions of OUG 194/2002.
Split into permit validity, work right, and long-term-residence qualification propositions.
